 Benfica 4 – 1 Live 85' Gil Vicente Lukébakio   36', 54' , Sudakov   40' , Durán   81' Lausen   56' , Morillas   82' Live Updated a few seconds ago Benfica vs Gil Vicente LIVE Score Updates in Taça da Liga Match
 Follow Benfica vs Gil Vicente live score, confirmed lineups, match stats, standings & minute-by-minute updates in Taça da Liga on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 29, 2026, 6:32 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 6:32 PM ET 85' 6:31 PM ET a few seconds ago Red card
 Espigares, on a counter-attack, raised his arm and struck Rafa Silva with his elbow, resulting in a straight red card and leaving Gil Vicente with one less player! Shortly after, Benfica made a substitution, with Jhon Durán leaving and Anísio Cabral entering.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments
 6:31 PM ET 85' Red card 
 6:30 PM ET 80' Goal by Jhon Durán · 4-1 
 6:16 PM ET 70' Yellow card 
 6:06 PM ET 60' Goal by Andreas Lausen · 3-1 
 6:03 PM ET 55' Goal by Dodi Lukébakio · 3-0 
 5:50 PM ET Second half starts 
 5:37 PM ET End of first half 
 5:35 PM ET 40' Goal by Georgiy Sudakov · 2-0 
 5:29 PM ET 35' Goal by Dodi Lukébakio · 1-0 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 80' 6:30 PM ET 2 minutes ago Goal for Benfica
 Rafa Silva received the ball, made a run, and found Jhon Durán with a pass in front of goal. Durán then unleashed a powerful shot into the top corner, further extending Benfica's lead over Gil Vicente!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 75' 6:22 PM ET 10 minutes ago Yellow and changes
 Benfica have now made three changes, with João Palhinha, Sudakov and Schjelderup leaving and Prestianni, Aursnes and Manu Silva entering. Shortly afterwards, Aursnes received a yellow card for a strong foul in midfield.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 70' 6:16 PM ET 16 minutes ago Yellow card
 João Palhinha received a yellow card for a heavy foul on Zé Carlos in midfield. In an attempt to make the play, El Karouani ended up sending the ball towards the goal, but Lenglet cleared the ball over the line!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 65' 6:10 PM ET 22 minutes ago Changes in Gil Vicente
 Gil Vicente, after reducing the deficit, made two substitutions, bringing on Walace França and Agustin Moreira for Kaba and Murilo. Jhon Durán, with a through ball, managed a powerful shot, but sent the ball wide to the right of the goal!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 60' 6:06 PM ET 26 minutes ago Goal for Gil Vicente
 Lausen, who came on at halftime, received the pass up front, carried the ball forward and shot from distance, sending the ball into the top left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance to save it, scoring a fantastic goal!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 55' 6:03 PM ET 29 minutes ago Goal for Benfica
 On the left, Benfica won a corner kick, taken at the near post, where the defense deflected the ball and it fell to Lukebakio who executed a bicycle kick, sending the ball into the back of the net and extending Benfica's lead!
 LUKEBAKIO 🇧🇪😍😍😍 https://t.co/kQDZ75en7G
— Ivow🇵🇹 (@ivow7_slb) October 29, 2026 
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 50' 5:55 PM ET 37 minutes ago At the post
 At halftime, Gil Vicente made two substitutions, with Guilherme and Gil Martins leaving and Lausen and Touré entering. Schjelderup received the pass up front and took a powerful long-range shot, hitting the post, in yet another dangerous attack!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5:50 PM ET 42 minutes ago Second half starts
 The players returned to the pitch at the Estádio da Luz and the ball rolled for the second half of the match between Benfica and Gil Vicente, in the Allianz Cup quarter-finals, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5:42 PM ET an hour ago Half-time statistics
 Benfica's dominance was evident in possession, totaling 60% compared to Gil Vicente's 40%, as well as in shots (14 vs. 4) and shots on goal (4 vs. 2), although Gil Vicente showed efficiency in those shots. It was a game with few fouls, only 11, with five by Benfica and six by Gil Vicente.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5:40 PM ET an hour ago First-half analysis and key takeaways
 Benfica were largely dominant in the first half, creating the best chances of the game. Despite this, early on, Gil Vicente managed to create dangerous opportunities. With these scares, the home team sped up the game to score and gain some breathing room.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5:37 PM ET an hour ago End of first half
 In a first half with chances for both sides, Benfica were efficient and managed to create dangerous opportunities in the attacking third, taking the lead with a good from Lukebakio, and extending their lead with a good from Sudakov, going into halftime with a 2-0 advantage!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 45' 5:35 PM ET an hour ago Out
 Jhon Durán received the pass up front and managed a powerful shot, but sent the ball into the side netting. Benfica, even with a 2-0 lead, maintains high pressure in the attacking third and creates dangerous chances! Live updates by Victor Cunha
 40' 5:35 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Benfica
 On the left, El Karouani received the pass, surged forward and delivered a low cross, which the defense cleared. The ball fell to Sudakov at the edge of the box, who struck a powerful shot into the top left corner of the net, extending the lead! Live updates by Victor Cunha
 35' 5:29 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Benfica
 On the right, Sudakov received the pass, carried it forward, and found the ball in the middle. The defense tried to clear it, but couldn't, and the ball fell to Lukebakio, who struck it powerfully into the right corner of the net, opening the scoring!
 🚨🇵🇹 | GOAL: DODI LUKEBAKIO OPENS THE SCORING FOR BENFICA!
Benfica 1-0 Gil Vicente. https://t.co/kATzH3h7J3
— TheGoalsZone (@TheGoalsZone) October 29, 2026 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 30' 5:20 PM ET an hour ago Samuel
 3Benfica continues the attack, in another passing sequence where the ball fell to Schjelderup who shot low from distance, but sent the ball into Samuel's hands, who caught it without giving up a rebound. Benfica continues to miss chances to open the scoring.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 25' 5:16 PM ET an hour ago Blocked
 Schjelderup was the name of the moment in the finishing, receiving the pass and entering the area, but his shot was saved. Benfica managed to maintain possession, exchanging passes and trying to create dangerous chances to open the scoring, so far without success.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 20' 5:09 PM ET an hour ago Samuel!
 Echeverri received the pass up front and took a powerful shot from distance, but Samuel palmed it away for a corner. The corner was crossed into the box, and Lenglet got a header, but sent the ball wide to the right of the goal!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 15' 5:07 PM ET an hour ago Blocked
 Zé Carlos received the pass up front and took a powerful long-range shot, but it was blocked by the defense. Shortly after, Benfica attacked again with a series of passes, where Echeverri had a chance after breaking into the box, but lost possession immediately.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 5:01 PM ET 2 hours ago Trubin
 David Moreira gets the first big chance of the game with a through ball, forcing Trubin to parry the ball away! Gil Vicente creates the first chance of the game, forcing Trubin to make an early save from the defense!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 5' 4:52 PM ET 2 hours ago Intense start
 We have a start where Benfica has possession, exchanging passes and trying to press in the attacking half, while Gil Vicente also tries to press, without setting up defensively to prevent dangerous attacks from the home team!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:47 PM ET 2 hours ago Here we go
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Benfica vs. Gil Vicente clash, in the first 45 minutes of this Allianz Cup quarter-final match, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:40 PM ET 2 hours ago Gil Vicente's bench
 For the game, Luis Pinto will have the following players available during the match against Benfica: Andre Picornell, Lucão, José Silva, Malik Gning, Joelso Fernandes, Martim Fernández, Tidjany Touré, Andreas Lausen, Sergio Bernejo, Agustin Moreira, Gonçalo Maia Pereira and Walace França.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:39 PM ET 2 hours ago Benfica's bench
 For the game, Marco Silva will have the following players available during the match against Gil Vicente: Samuel Soares, João Fonseca, Tomás Araújo, Alexander Bah, Gianluca Prestianni, Manu Silva, Tiago Freitas, Jakub Kaminski, Rafa Silva, Anisio Cabral and Pavlidis.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:36 PM ET 2 hours ago Gil Vicente lined-up!
 With a 3-4-3 formation, Gil Vicente's starting lineup for the Taça da Liga (Allianz Cup) match against Porto is: Samuel, Espigares, Buatu and Moreira; Esgaio, García, Carlos and Guilherme; Murilo, Kaba and Martins.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:34 PM ET 2 hours ago Benfica lined-up!
 With a 4-2-3-1 formation, Benfica's starting lineup for the Allianz Cup match against Gil Vicente is: Trubin, El-Karouani, Circati, Lenglet and Dahl; João Palhinha, Sudakov, Lukebakio, Echevetti and Schjelderup; Jhon Durán.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4:25 PM ET 2 hours ago Benfica vs Gil Vicente Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
